speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are upright. That is as much as I require of a Tuesday night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Upright is the report, Mistress. There is no second half of it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The band came home on you. I am not asking where it went.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not ask. The loaf is short of the notch by two fingers, and the price is a penny. A parlour has not changed either fact.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two fingers, and a penny. I am not measuring them against Westminster.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The loom was a loom. If the close has a story, it did not come through the kitchen.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Church was yesterday. I am not collecting kings at dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then you are not owed one. The afternoon is the lovers again. It is not a new play.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not ask if the one who dies is still a boy. You answered that on Sunday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And the answer can live in Sunday. Eat, and go when you go. I have the notch, and I do not need a guest to set beside it.
